import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from crosscheck.common_utils import select_band, band_of_values, reduce_ratio, scenario_weight

FAILS = []

def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILS.append(name); print('FAIL', name, got, '!=', want)
    else:
        print('pass', name)

check('single value', select_band([(7, 5)], 0), (7, 5))
